I own all three pink properties, forming a Monopoly. I also hold unmortgaged orange and yellow properties. I notice buildable_space_keys is empty, which prevents building houses.

I am mapping the standard Monopoly color groups to verify which properties belong to each player. I need to confirm whether St. James Place is orange or pink, since that determines whether p4 holds a pink monopoly.

I misremembered the color groupings. I do not own a pink monopoly because p4 holds Virginia Avenue. I actually own all three orange properties, including the mortgaged New York Avenue.

Unmortgaging New York Avenue costs $110, leaving $159. I am weighing whether to unmortgage it now or wait, since the engine may ask again if building becomes legal.

I now see that buying one house on the orange properties after unmortgaging New York would leave only $59. p4 holds light blue hotels worth $550 to $600 each, while p3 owns brown hotels at $250 and $450. p4 has $3,205 in cash, giving them a massive lead.

I am reassessing my strategy. I will hold onto the mortgaged New York Avenue and avoid building. My current holdings serve as blockers: Marvin Gardens blocks yellow, and St. Charles Place and States Avenue block pink.

I now see that p4 cannot complete a pink monopoly without both of those properties from me. The yellow group is split between p4 and me, so it cannot form a monopoly unless p4 acquires the third piece. Red and green are also split across players.

I am now calculating the exact rent values for houses on St. James Place and Tennessee Avenue to determine whether an orange monopoly could bankrupt p4.

I should avoid trading away my pink properties or Marvin Gardens to p4, since that would complete monopolies for the leader. I am now considering whether to acquire Virginia Avenue from p4 to complete a pink monopoly.

p4 will not trade Virginia Avenue cheaply. Pink houses cost $100, and p4 has $3,205, so they will not give up a property for anything I can offer.

p2 could unmortgage Park Place with their $222 cash. They cannot build houses because each costs $200. A dark blue monopoly without houses would only double the rent to about $70 on Park Place and $100 on Boardwalk. That is not lethal.

I considered giving p2 cash to build dark blue houses, but even with all my money they could only afford one house each after unmortgaging. That would leave them broke and unable to hurt p4. I will not fund p2.

I cannot buy Atlantic Avenue because I am on the Chance space. I will not mortgage any properties early, since that would lose rent and pay 10% interest. I am calculating exact mortgage values for my pink properties to preserve cash.

I calculated that mortgaging all six properties would raise $535, giving me about $804 in total liquidity. That could cover one light blue hotel but not two hits. I will not mortgage anything until I absolutely need cash. I am now ending my turn.

I am now considering selling one pink property for cash to survive a hotel hit. p4 already owns Virginia, so one pink does not complete their monopoly. They may not pay much for it, and I would lose rent income. With $3,205 in cash, they likely do not care about small rent payments.
